phase2_deploy_built.title: AI Product Description Writing
phase2_deploy_built.justification: This opportunity is specifically right for Baukjen now because it can help improve product descriptions, which are crucial for AI-assisted product discovery and personalisation, and Baukjen has a staff digital literacy score of 5.55, indicating a good foundation for implementation.

deliverables.name: configuration_guide_claude_api
deliverables.content: To configure Claude API for Baukjen, start by integrating the API with their Shopify store using Zapier or a similar integration tool. Next, set up the AI writing assistant to generate product descriptions based on product photos and bullet points, and customize the brand voice and tone to match Baukjen's high-end, sustainable fashion aesthetic. Finally, train the model on Baukjen's existing product descriptions to improve accuracy and consistency.
deliverables.instructions: Configuration guide for Claude API, ranked #1 for this business.

recommended_ai_agents.name: Loop Returns
recommended_ai_agents.what_it_does_here: Returns management platform for Shopify merchants that converts refunds into exchanges. When a customer initiates a return, Loop suggests alternative products, different sizes, or store credit. Directly reduces refund leakage for fashion brands with high size-related return rates. Provides structured returns data as a byproduct.

recommended_ai_agents.name: Klaviyo + Mailchimp dual deployment
recommended_ai_agents.what_it_does_here: Not a single tool but a strategy: running primary email flows in Klaviyo while maintaining a Mailchimp backup list ensures no single marketing automation vendor holds all customer communication. Both export subscriber lists in standard CSV — satisfying Data (Use and Access) Act 2025 portability requirements.
recommended_ai_agents.estimated_monthly_cost_gbp: Mailchimp free up to 500 contacts. Klaviyo free up to 250 contacts
